drawn as a soft glow following the line of the plantar fascia rather than as a shaded area showing where load concentrates. The checkable form of the rule is in TRIGGER at 1.9 - remove the culprit from the frame and ask whether the harmful state disappears. Here it does not.

notes: verdict_by: harness (ADR-011), from the render in hand. What this render does establish, and it is the one useful thing in it: paper-cut is a REAL style on this model. The scales came back as separate cut layers with hard edges and cast shadows, unmistakably distinct from both airbrushed and flat-vector, which is the visual variety the owner asked for. But every mark in the frame degraded at the same time - counts wrong on measure and contour, fill half-delivered - so paper-cut is recorded as visually successful and mark-hostile on its founding render, and it needs a second run on a prompt whose argument is sound before anything is concluded.
